The '''''Reclaimer''''' was a customized salvage [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of [[Belinda Vog]]. It carried two crew, four passengers, 75 metric tons of cargo, and 1 month's consumables. It had a class 1 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and a class 15 backup. It could fly 750 kmh in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and had a [[Navigation computer/Legends|nav computer]]. It was equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] as well as a heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]].
